verdict.rationale: The core online filing flow is account-gated: the patent filing page says you need One Login details or must set them up before filing online. The trade mark page says only that you can apply "online or by post" and documents no keyless or file-number entry path. The paper or email fallback is not an online flow, and search-by-number is an adjacent search feature rather than an entry path into filing, so neither earns credit.
